section13_checks.prohibition_description: Treating Grant Agreement Annex templates as the governing structural schema for proposal writing.
Inventing call constraints, scope requirements, expected outcomes, or expected impacts not present in Tier 2B.
Inventing project facts (partners, capabilities, roles, objectives, prior experience, budget figures) not present in Tier 3.
Commencing Phase 8 activity before the budget gate (Phase 7) has passed, or asserting budget-dependent content without a passed budget gate.
Storing durable decisions only in agent memory without writing them to Tier 4.
Allowing a workflow or skill to become a de facto constitutional authority.
Silently reordering phases or weakening gate conditions.
Finalizing proposal text when source state is incomplete/contradictory/unvalidated without explicitly flagging the gap in the deliverable.
section13_checks.violation_evidence: validation_status.overall_status is 'unresolved' and no_unsupported_claims_declaration is true, yet claim MOBILITY_ELIGIBILITY carries status 'unresolved' with summary 'Whether the European Fellowship mobility rule is satisfied rests on an operator-declared assumption (rectified CV giving 7.05 months in Hungary against a 12-month cap); the CV's face count is contested and it is not confirmed.' The section therefore reads as complete while carrying an unflagged unresolved claim.

Modifying Tier 1 or Tier 2 source documents to reflect project-specific assumptions.
Treating CLAUDE.md as advisory or optional.

decision_log_entries.resolution_note: Constitutional violation detected; requires human operator resolution.
